events.section: Development of a nanobody blocking the LGR4-RSPO1/2 complex
Development and structural characterization of an LGR4 inhibitory nanobody

cause: An overly broad section-title filter intended to identify nanobody role emitted complete structural Results subsections.
mitigation: Subsequent prose review was restricted to construct, reagent production, sample and data-availability sections. No contact or orientation details were propagated into evidence or decisions.
impact: The six LGR4 review entries and related lead 9UOK are exposure-blocked pending formal adjudication; do not describe them as wholly unexposed holdouts. This record does not silently alter the frozen protocol or master ledger.
